features.title: Full-pipeline e2e in npm test
features.user_visible_behavior: npm test fails when a phase, a gate, a runtime hook, or a registry command stops working end to end.
features.evidence: full-pipeline.sh OK (~11 s): claude+cursor hooks allow/deny/release, observe fail-open; 9 phases → DONE, check --live and drift pass; skipped phase → QG-DEC-09; 48 commands --help, every harness command ran with expected exits. npm test 502 pass. Restamped for 3.14.0: npm test 502 pass + full-pipeline OK.
